name: News Dashboard
author: paudelsamir
description: A unified Omarchy news reader: RSS and Atom feeds in one quiet panel with categories, source filters, saved stories, for-you, and full customization.

barWidget.description: Unread pill in the bar; a dense, themed news panel with Home, For you, Saved and Settings.

schema.label: Bar badge
schema.description: Choose an icon, unread dot, unread-only count, always-visible count, or For You count.

schema.label: Show in bar
schema.description: Show or hide the News capsule while keeping the plugin available through its shortcut.

schema.label: Capsule tone
schema.description: Choose how prominent the capsule looks in the bar.

schema.label: Capsule density
schema.description: Choose the capsule footprint in the bar.

schema.label: Refresh every (minutes)
schema.description: How often the feeds are fetched in the background.

schema.label: Articles per source
schema.description: How many recent articles to keep from each feed.
